subject.title: fix: preserve Feishu post line breaks

question: Should maintainers continue with this clean but unproven bounded-fallback branch, require live proof first, or switch to the proof-positive broader sibling fix?
rationale: The remaining blocker is maintainer acceptance of Feishu message-delivery behavior and canonical branch selection, not a narrow mechanical repair.

options.title: Require proof on this branch
options.body: Ask the contributor to add redacted Feishu/Lark rendered-message proof for prose, fenced code, raw tables, and near-limit fallback before this branch can merge.

options.title: Adopt the proof-positive sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99394 as the canonical fix if maintainers prefer its broader rechunking and fanout behavior.

options.title: Accept the bounded fallback
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept that near-limit messages keep original single newlines to avoid oversized Feishu post sends.

recommendation.title: Require proof on this branch
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to add redacted Feishu/Lark rendered-message proof for prose, fenced code, raw tables, and near-limit fallback before this branch can merge.
